sources.finding: Read NVIDIA's MLPerf 6.1 preview article: Rubin NVL72 reports Qwen3-VL up to 3.7x and DeepSeek-R1 up to 2.5x GB300 NVL72. Preview category and software/scenario dependence retained; no availability or revenue claim inferred.

Read NVIDIA's AEMA launch article. Emerald AI, Google and NVIDIA propose performance-based load flexibility, response metrics and interconnection pathways; this is industry advocacy, not enacted regulation or approved MW.

Read SK hynix's FACT response to September 16 reporting. The company says neither Ohio leasing nor an Intel/cloud-company venture is decided. Do not change 'not finalized' into a categorical denial of discussions.

Read the September 15 Moore Threads announcement in the browser after its dynamic body loaded: MTT S5000 server joint R&D, end-to-end validation, pass-through, TEE isolation and secure CPU-GPU links. Mainstream-model validation continues; no order or installed scale stated.

Read AirTrunk's September 15 MoU announcement. Cryogenic cooling and quantum-ready infrastructure are exploratory with techno-economic evaluation. The source does not establish a commercial facility or achieved savings.

Read NVIDIA's September 15 AI Infra Summit article. Lambda validation fits 19 Blackwell nodes into the budget normally serving 16 at full power, with about 24% higher token output and 23% performance-per-watt gain. Customer-specific test, not a universal fleet result.
